# elemento_compute (Resource)

The elemento compute resource



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `additional_info` (Attributes) Additional information for the compute resource. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--additional_info))
- `billing_frequency` (String) The frequency at which the compute resource should be billed. Valid values are 'day', 'week', 'month', and 'year'.
- `region` (String) The region in which the compute resource should be created.
- `requirements` (Attributes) The elemento compute requirements (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--requirements))
- `vm_name` (String) The name of the virtual machine to be created.
- `volumes` (Attributes List) The list of storage volumes required for the compute resource. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--volumes))

### Optional

- `authentication` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--authentication))
- `cloudinit` (Attributes) The cloud-init configuration for the compute resource. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--cloudinit))

### Read-Only

- `billing_uuid` (String) The billing UUID of the compute resource, assigned by the Elemento API after creation.
- `last_updated` (String) The timestamp of the last update to the compute resource.
- `payment_url` (String) The payment URL for the compute resource, assigned by the Elemento API after creation.
- `tags` (String) The tags associated with the compute resource, assigned by the Elemento API after creation.
- `uuid` (String) The UUID of the compute resource, assigned by the Elemento API after creation.

<a id="nestedatt--requirements--cpu"></a>
### Nested Schema for `requirements.cpu`

Required:

- `allow_smt` (Boolean) Whether SMT (Simultaneous Multithreading) is allowed for the CPU.
- `arch` (List of String) The list of alternative CPU architectures required for the compute resource. Valid values are 'X86_64' and 'arm64'.
- `full_physical` (Boolean) Whether the CPU slots should be a full physical CPU core (no hyperthreading).
- `max_overprovision` (Number) The maximum overprovisioning factor for the CPU slots.
- `slots` (Number) The number of CPU slots required for the compute resource.
- `smt_enabled` (Boolean) Whether SMT (Simultaneous Multithreading) is enabled for the CPU.

Optional:

- `flags` (List of String) The list of CPU flags required for the compute resource.
- `min_frequency` (Number) The minimum frequency (in GHz) required for the CPU.


<a id="nestedatt--requirements--memory"></a>
### Nested Schema for `requirements.memory`

Required:

- `capacity` (Number) The memory capacity (in MB) required for the compute resource.
- `require_ecc` (Boolean) Whether ECC (Error-Correcting Code) memory is required for the compute resource.


<a id="nestedatt--requirements--misc"></a>
### Nested Schema for `requirements.misc`

Optional:

- `os_family` (String) The operating system family required for the compute resource. Valid values are 'linux', 'windows', and 'macos'.
- `os_flavour` (String) The operating system flavour required for the compute resource.


<a id="nestedatt--requirements--pci"></a>
### Nested Schema for `requirements.pci`

Required:

- `devices` (Map of Number) A map of PCI device names to the number of devices required for the compute resource.
